Chapter 764: Chapter 39: Fusion Of Time And Space (Thanks To The Alliance Hierarch Reward From The Book Friend '知人_论世')

Chapter 764: Chapter 39: Fusion of Time and Space (Thanks to the Alliance Hierarch reward from the book friend ‘知人_论世’)

Virtual World.

With a solemn expression, Xia Qin Supreme Being spoke from his throne, “Are you saying that the ‘White Paper’ already has an owner?”

In the Main Universe’s past, objects from beyond often squeezed through the Eternal Spatial Rift.

Most of these objects were ‘inanimate.’

For instance, the recent Cosmic Aurora from beyond.

However, a small portion were ‘living beings.’

During the years when human civilization lay dormant, an odd life form squeezed through the Eternal Spatial Rift on the large battlefield carved out by the Insect Race and the Tianyu Clan.

This odd life form nearly brought an irreversible disaster to the Cosmic Starry Skies.

In the end, over a dozen Supreme Beings joined hands and barely managed to exile the odd life form back to the outside of the universe.

In comparison, the uncertainty of ‘living beings’ is far greater, enough to make even the Ultimate Beings vigilant.

If what Lin Yuan said is correct, then the ‘White Paper’ already has an owner.

And it resides within the ‘White Paper’ itself.

Then, these Ultimate Beings would have to reassess how to deal with it.

“It cannot be said to have an owner, but at least it has birthed a ‘spirit,’ possessing an independent will,” Lin Yuan spoke of his conjecture.

According to the half-meter-tall elder’s words, the Two-dimensional World within the White Paper was likely created by an existence close to that of a Perfect Time Being.

Yet, the half-meter-tall elder himself did not seem like one close to a Perfect Time Being,

He was more like an existence akin to a ‘spirit,’

or perhaps a ‘caretaker’ casually created by the original being close to a Perfect Time Being.

“As long as it possesses an independent will, it is considered a ‘living being.'”

Xia Qin Supreme Being furrowed his brows, “No wonder these past hundred years, our multiple attempts at Refining it have yielded no results.”

With the means of Ultimate Beings, if it truly were ownerless, it wouldn’t completely be Refined, but at least there would be some hope.

But in reality, their methods of Refining the ‘White Paper’ were completely without any feedback.

“There is another matter,” Lin Yuan hesitated before continuing: “The Evolvers of my human civilization, once entered into the Two-dimensional World, will likely not be able to come back out.”

Immediately, Lin Yuan repeated the half-meter-tall elder’s words.

“Only one from the Myriad Clans’ lives that fall into the Two-dimensional World can ultimately walk out,” Lin Yuan conveyed truthfully.

“So that’s how it is,” Xia Qin Supreme Being fell silent for a while before swiftly accepting the fact.

If Lin Yuan were not involved, the human civilization’s Evolvers would have had no chance of leaving based on normal progression.

If Lin Yuan hadn’t fallen into the Two-dimensional World, it should have been the stage for special life forms and the ultimate victor would have likely been those of legendary special beings like the Four Divine Kings.

Lin Yuan becoming the final victor inside the Two-dimensional World had already pleased Xia Qin Supreme Being immensely, if only because it meant not facing fundamental loss.

Moreover, Lin Yuan mentioned that the final victor would receive a corresponding reward.

Of course, as for what that reward was, Xia Qin Supreme Being didn’t ask further; it was Lin Yuan’s own fortune.

“It’s very good.”

“Do not feel burdened, it’s not because of you that they can’t come out,” Xia Qin Supreme Being offered a few words of comfort to Lin Yuan.

The fact remained just that, and even Lin Yuan’s appearance had mitigated some of the loss.

After all, he had brought out many strange objects; even if Lin Yuan took half, and human civilization took a portion of what remained,

to each human Evolver, these objects were still immensely precious.

Even if they couldn’t restore the fundamental loss of numerous human Evolvers, they could compensate for most of it in other ways.

“No one else knows about this, right?” Xia Qin Supreme Being suddenly inquired.

“They should not,” Lin Yuan pondered for a moment before nodding.

Even he only speculated this from the difficulty change when the Heavenly Gates opened twice, and after entering the gates seeing the half-meter-tall elder to have it fully confirmed.

As for other Myriad Clan lives? They never even had the chance to be in contact with the Heavenly Gates, let alone think in this direction or be aware of the issue.

…

Two-dimensional World.

Lin Yuan sat obediently in the corner, secretly observing his surroundings.

“Are you wondering, the lives that entered the Heavenly Gates depicted in the scroll, where are they now?” the half-meter-tall elder glanced at Lin Yuan before the massive scroll and casually commented.

“I’m just a bit curious,” Lin Yuan admitted he had been pondering this.

How long is the history in the Two-dimensional World? It’s likely calculated in Cosmic Eras.

Going by the Heavenly Gates opening every ten thousand years, there should have been a large number of lives leaving the Two-dimensional World.

“The creator of this Low-dimensional Space, that existence close to a Perfect Time Being was benevolent, believing that even the most insignificant low-dimensional life should have the freedom to break free from all,”

“Hence, the Heavenly Gates open once every ten thousand years,” said the half-meter-tall elder.

“Any life that steps through the Heavenly Gates can shed the nature of a low-dimensional life; I usually toss them into a nearby universe.”

“Oh, and for your universe, I’ve thrown in quite a few. A large number of them have already died off,” the half-meter-tall elder said casually.

The initial intention behind creating this Low-dimensional Space was to explore even lower dimensions. Secondly, it was discovered that if one parts with a sliver of Spiritual Will, it enables a comparison of understanding from the same starting point.

This latter purpose gradually became the main use of this Low-dimensional Space. Over the long years of continuous improvement, a complete Low-dimensional World was fostered, with endless low-dimensional lives proliferating within it.

Later, following a major upheaval, this Low-dimensional Space fell silent within the Taiyuan Relic. As Cosmic Eras passed by, it was ejected again by the various forces within the relic, and it automatically began to absorb all nearby lives, sucking them into the Two-dimensional World.
